observed.caption: A wide urban street with vehicles, pedestrians, billboards and a tall glass building under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A paved multi-lane road stretches into the distance with white lane markings, bordered by dirt verges and sidewalks. Several cars drive on the left lanes. Utility poles with overhead wires line the left side. Green trees and bushes line both sides of the road and the center median. A tall modern building with glass windows and an orange vertical stripe stands in the center background. Multiple billboards and signs are visible, including a large partially cut-off billboard on the right edge, a red and yellow billboard on the left, a blue and white directional sign in the center median, and a stacked signpost on the right sidewalk. Several small human figures in casual clothing walk along the right sidewalk and beside the road. The sky is pale gray and overcast.
